# Open Ports Commercial War
oe_war2_cb_open_ports_war = {
	trade = yes
	speed = 15
	war_goal_type = enforce_tariff_exemption

	create_visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_ports = yes
		NOT = { country_type = navy }
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
		exists = scope:target
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
			num_of_ports >= 2
		}
		OR = {
			scope:target = { is_embargoing = root }
			is_rival_of = scope:target
			opinion = { target = scope:target value < -20 }
		}
	}

	create_enabled = {
		has_ports = yes
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
		NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:target }
		NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
			num_of_ports >= 2
			OR = {
				has_markets = yes
				country_economical_base >= 25
			}
		}
		OR = {
			scope:target = { is_embargoing = root }
			is_rival_of = scope:target
			opinion = { target = scope:target value < -20 }
		}
	}

	declare_enabled = {
		has_ports = yes
		scope:target = { num_of_ports >= 1 }
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "BASE"
			value = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
			add = {
				desc = "DIPLO_ALLIED"
				value = -100
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = { is_embargoing = root }
				navy_size >= scope:target.navy_size
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_WAR2_CB_OPEN_PORTS_REASON"
				value = 50
			}
		}
	}
}

# Recover Plundered Heritage
oe_war2_cb_recover_heritage = {
	trade = no
	speed = 18
	war_goal_type = superiority

	create_visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		exists = scope:target
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
		}
		OR = {
			scope:target = {
				any_work_of_art_in_country = {
					art_is_priceless = no
					origin ?= {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = { this = root }
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = oe_war2_plundered_by
				var:oe_war2_plundered_by ?= scope:target
			}
		}
	}

	create_enabled = {
		NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:target }
		NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
		}
		OR = {
			scope:target = {
				any_work_of_art_in_country = {
					art_is_priceless = no
					origin ?= {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = { this = root }
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = oe_war2_plundered_by
				var:oe_war2_plundered_by ?= scope:target
			}
		}
	}

	declare_enabled = {
		scope:target = { NOT = { this = root } }
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "BASE"
			value = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
			add = {
				desc = "DIPLO_ALLIED"
				value = -100
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				army_size >= scope:target.army_size
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_WAR2_CB_HERITAGE_REASON"
				value = 45
			}
		}
	}
}

# Defend Neutral Buffer
oe_war2_cb_defend_buffer = {
	trade = no
	speed = 16
	war_goal_type = superiority

	create_visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
		OR = {
			country_rank_level >= 3
			is_great_power = yes
		}
		exists = scope:target
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
		}
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_buffer_winner
			AND = {
				has_variable = oe_war2_buffer_guarantor_against
				var:oe_war2_buffer_guarantor_against ?= scope:target
			}
			is_rival_of = scope:target
		}
	}

	create_enabled = {
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
		NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:target }
		NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
			OR = {
				is_neighbor_of = root
				within_diplomatic_range = root
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_buffer_winner
			AND = {
				has_variable = oe_war2_buffer_guarantor_against
				var:oe_war2_buffer_guarantor_against ?= scope:target
			}
			AND = {
				scope:target = { at_war = yes }
				is_rival_of = scope:target
			}
		}
	}

	declare_enabled = {
		scope:target = { NOT = { this = root } }
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "BASE"
			value = -30
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
			add = {
				desc = "DIPLO_ALLIED"
				value = -100
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = { at_war = yes }
				army_size >= scope:target.army_size
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_WAR2_CB_BUFFER_REASON"
				value = 50
			}
		}
	}
}

# Enforce Balance of Power
oe_war2_cb_enforce_balance = {
	trade = no
	speed = 14
	war_goal_type = superiority
	cut_down_in_size_cb = yes

	create_visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
		OR = {
			is_great_power = yes
			country_rank_level >= 3
		}
		exists = scope:target
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
			OR = {
				is_great_power = yes
				is_hegemon = yes
				country_rank_level >= 4
			}
		}
	}

	create_enabled = {
		NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:target }
		NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
			OR = {
				is_great_power = yes
				is_hegemon = yes
				country_rank_level >= 4
			}
		}
		OR = {
			is_rival_of = scope:target
			scope:target = { is_hegemon = yes }
			opinion = { target = scope:target value < -40 }
		}
	}

	declare_enabled = {
		scope:target = {
			OR = {
				is_great_power = yes
				is_hegemon = yes
				country_rank_level >= 4
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "BASE"
			value = -35
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
			add = {
				desc = "DIPLO_ALLIED"
				value = -100
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = { is_hegemon = yes }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_WAR2_CB_BALANCE_REASON"
				value = 55
			}
		}
	}
}
